title: Mary K. Sturdivant as Lockheed insider who helped kill Kona Blue

tellings.quote: there may have been a conflict of interest within Loheed Martin maybe an insider in Loheed who helped put the kibos on the program

plain: A person named Mary K. Sturdivant is suggested to have been an insider at Lockheed Martin, a big American defense contractor, who helped shut down Kona Blue, a proposed government program tied to the study of UFOs, in the years between 2006 and 2021. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb raises this as a possibility, not a finding, saying there "may have been a conflict of interest" inside the company. If true, it would mean a private contractor helped stop the government from taking on the subject.
